benchmark_rationale: The DUT is a panic-path QR generator integrated into drm_panic.c rather than a standalone registered driver

The meaningful seam is the QR ABI plus the C-owned panic integration path, not subsystem registration
why_not_full_driver: No registration object is introduced by the QR encoder itself
The current-tree Rust file only exports qr generator ABI entry points
panic draw and zlib flow remain inside drm_panic.c
